title: Add an explicit safe reparent/restack workflow for a single-parent tws stack. Let an operator change one logical entry's configured base to another in-stack parent or explicit Git ref, preview the old parent, recorded cutoff, new destination, replay set, affected descendant closure, branch/ref collateral, metadata changes, and remote/PR retargeting guidance before mutation, then atomically replay the selected branch and required descendants while updating stack.yaml base and last_base_sha only after Git success. Support external and checkout workspace modes, decoupled logical/Git branch names, existing scoped sync semantics, interrupted-run recovery, and the merged-parent case where master is A-B'-D and PR2 carries A-B-C so only C is replayed onto D. Preserve no-flag sync behavior. Keep multi-parent composition, patch-equivalence inference, automatic remote PR retargeting, and arbitrary branch import out of scope.
notes: Phase advanced manually (--manual); artifact authored at analysis.md
